- Count steps.

She wants to know the minimum number of digits she needs to replace in order to make the ticket lucky.The ticket is considered lucky if the sum of first three digits equals to the sum of last three digits.
source_data.prob_desc_output_spec: Print one number — the minimum possible number of digits Luba needs to replace to make the ticket lucky.

It's easy to see that at least two replacements are required.In the third example Luba can replace any zero with 3. It's easy to see that at least one replacement is required.
